Suppose $T : \mathscr{C} \to \mathscr{C}$ is an idempotent endofunctor, with $\mu : T^2 \xrightarrow{\;\cong\;} T$. 

> [!def]
> An expansion of $T$ is an object $A \in \mathscr{C}$ together with a morphism $a : A \to TA$ such that $\mu \circ Ta = 1$. Expansions of $T$ form a category, $\mathsf{Exp}(T)$, which is a full subcategory of $T$-coalgebras. 

Denote the forgetful functor as follows.
$$
U : \mathsf{Exp}(T) \to \mathscr{C}
$$
***lemma.*** Suppose $\mathscr{C}$ has a zero object, and  $T0 = 0$. Then $\mathsf{Exp}(T)$ has a zero object.
***proof.*** $0 : 0 \to 0$ is an expansion and is the zero object.

***lemma.*** Again suppose $T$ preservers zero. Suppose $f : A \to B$ is a morphism in $\mathsf{Exp}(T)$ such that kernel of $Uf$ exists (in $\mathscr{C}$) and is preserved by $T$ in the sense the following diagram commutes. It follows that $\ker f$ exists (in $\mathsf{Exp}(T)$) and is preserved by $U$.

***lemma.*** Suppose $\mathscr{C}$ is preabelian, and $T$ is additive and preserves strict epimorphisms. Then pushouts in $\mathsf{Exp}(T)$ are created by the forgetful functor $\mathsf{Exp}(T) \to \mathscr{C}$.
***proof.*** Suppose $f : A \to B$ and $g : A \to C$ are formal maps on expansions $z_A$, $z_B$, and $z_C$. First, observe their pushout forms a $T$-coalgebra.
<iframe class="quiver-embed" src="https://q.uiver.app/#&embed" width="100%" height="250" style="border-radius: 8px; border: none;"></iframe>
It remains to show that $\mu \circ T z_P = 1$. Note that we can write the the pushout as follows.$$ A \xrightarrow{\langle f,\,-g\rangle} B \oplus C \xtwoheadrightarrow{[i_B,\,i_C]} P = \mathrm{coker} \langle f,\,-g\rangle$$Applying $T$ to our diagram, we find that $[Ti_B, Ti_C]$ is an epimorphism. $$ TA \xrightarrow{\langle Tf,\,-Tg\rangle} TB \oplus TC \xtwoheadrightarrow{[Ti_B,\,Ti_C]} TP$$Therefore, showing that $\mu \circ Tz_P \circ [Ti_B,\,Ti_C] = [Ti_B,\,Ti_C]$ by applying $T$ to the cube diagram, we are done.
<iframe class="quiver-embed" src="https://q.uiver.app/#&embed" width="100%" height="300" style="border-radius: 8px; border: none;"></iframe>
***corollary.*** Supposing $T$ is additive, and preserves strict epis, cokernels exist in $\mathsf{Exp}(T)$ are created by $U$.
